settings.title: Theme
settings.description: The stylesheet the window is drawn with.

settings.title: Light or dark
settings.description: Which half of a color pair the theme is read as. A theme that declares light and dark itself leaves this nothing to choose.

settings.title: Interface size
settings.description: Scale of controls and interface text. 1 is the default.

settings.title: Reading size
settings.description: Scale of note and book text. 1 is the default.

settings.title: Sync title and filename
settings.description: Renaming one also renames the other.

settings.title: Window buttons
settings.description: Where the window draws its minimise, maximise and close buttons on Linux: at the right like Windows, or at the left like macOS.

options.title: Right
options.detail: Square buttons at the right, as on Windows.

options.title: Left
options.detail: Round buttons at the left, as on macOS.

settings.title: Performance profile
settings.description: How much of the hardware indexing and models may use.
